title: Run xcodegen and verify test suite passes
description: Run 'xcodegen generate' from the repo root to register all new Swift source files added under CookbookApp/Common/, CookbookApp/Tabs/, and CookbookApp/Settings/ with the Xcode project. Then run 'xcodebuild test' with the configured scheme to confirm the full test suite passes, including the new shell-structure tests. Confirm no ContentView references remain.
acceptance_criteria: xcodebuild test exits 0 with zero test failures
Shell-structure tests (AppRoot tab order, SettingsView instantiation) pass
No ContentView symbol references remain anywhere in the source tree
No out-of-scope code (UIDocumentPicker, real settings logic, CookLang parsing) is present
